HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Physical Aspect of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical Aspect of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Physical Aspect of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Physical Aspect of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical Aspect of Yoga.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Friendship and Keeping Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Say Friendship and Keeping Promises has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Friendship and Keeping Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Friendship and Keeping Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Friendship and Keeping Promises.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

5. Which response best shows understanding of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
   B. Say Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Stories and Family Values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Scriptural Stories and Family Values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Scriptural Stories and Family Values has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Stories and Family Values.
   D. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Stories and Family Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Medicinal Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Say Medicinal Trees has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Medicinal Trees to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Medicinal Trees.
   D. Apply the teaching of Medicinal Trees with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Medicinal Trees and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptural Stories and Family Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
